details:
Vive XR Elite -

VRChat doesn't correctly detect if the current input system is using finger tracking or controller tracking. What this leads to is a situation where you're holding the controllers in your hands (and the XR is tracking them, and as such has disabled the hand/finger tracking), but VRC still thinks you're using finger tracking. Because the controller is on and running, you can't make the pinch gesture to click things, so you're essentially soft locked on the settings screen, unable to click anything or make changes. (in my case, I was stuck on a screen saying "Hey your bidings are jacked, click this thing to change them [in vrchat] or go to steam vr settings and do it there" which I've never really had to do before, coming from a Valve Index. 

This was probably the most furiously frustrated I've ever been trying to figure out how to make it all work, access steam, and try to fix the problem. It probably doesn't help that the default controller bindings for the focus 3 controllers (which XR Elite uses) don't work, and the community bindings are confusing and unintuitive. 

Anyway, through some combination of disabling the controllers, switching in and out of VRChat, pinch-clicking off finger tracking, then going back to the XR Elite settings, turning the controllers back on, maybe restarting VRC or SteamVR, and then dealing with all the wacky bindings I managed to at least get it somewhat working but it was not trivial. 

I think a compromise work around for this would be to always honor at least the trigger pull from any controller, if you're in finger tracking mode, so that you can interact with the settings UI to, for example, disable finger tracking!
title: Vive XR Elite - Switching between hand tracking and controllers - Soft Lock
